cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave your desk and stand by the open window, please. We'll start with following one clear instruction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Instruction first, questions afterward. I'd like to establish that my team can manage that order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing. Can I get my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then come back and hold it for me. Hold it, please; I haven't asked you to put it on.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 sequence correction serves obedience testing, and A5 coat fetch adds inconvenience, but final put-it-on warning is not earned by B conduct.

responseLogic.evidence: B4 cold and coat request follow open window; A5 holding A coat is clear without assuming B wore it.

relationship.evidence: B2 purpose question and B4 warmth concern remain plausible and useful.

heightening.evidence: B4 coat request earns extra fetching and holding; last warning adds a hypothetical mistake B never suggested.

specificity.evidence: A1 desk and open window plus B4 cold establish immediate physical cost.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 hold-versus-wear warning is detachable fussiness rather than needed instruction.
